title: NEXARA Memory Brain — Phase 1 Implementation Scope Contract V1
description: Frozen implementation scope for the Memory Foundation layer (Memory Brain + Long-term Memory). Defines exact files, interfaces, schemas, test requirements, evidence requirements, and forbidden modifications. Governed by NSEC V2.1. Implementation starts only after Claude review PASS + human approval.
governed_by: NSEC V2.1 Article 1 (Fixed Engineering Loop), Article 8 (Maximum Reachable Endpoint), Article 37 (High-Impact Approval), Article 45 (Definition of Done)

mission_scope.objective: Implement the Memory Foundation layer: MemoryBrainAPI (enhanced MemoryController with persistence, decay, ranking, health) + LongTermMemoryAPI (consolidation, reinforcement, supersession, GC, provenance).
mission_scope.implementation_strategy: Enhance existing src/nexara_prime/brain/memory_controller.py with persistence + ranking + decay + health. Add src/nexara_prime/brain/long_term_memory.py as new module. Create brain_state.db schema. ZERO runtime modification.
what_is_implemented: 1. MemoryStorageContract — formal interface + brain_state.db schema with 6 tables
2. MemoryObjectSchema — MemoryBrainRecord, DecayState, ConsolidationLog, HealthSnapshot JSON schemas
3. MemoryClassification — extended classification: decay half-life per kind, confidence scoring, layer promotion rules
4. MemoryRetrievalInterface — rank_retrieve() with relevance+recency scoring, cross_layer_query() across all 4 layers
5. MemoryEvidenceBinding — all brain memory writes require evidence_id; provenance chain to source evidence
6. MemoryIsolationBoundary — brain_state.db separate from store.db; brain/ package with zero runtime imports

brain_memory_controller.current_state: In-memory 4-layer controller with commit/recall/consolidate/summary. Evidence binding enforced for non-working layers. Consolidation: episodic→semantic on mission completion. ALL DATA IS IN-MEMORY — lost on restart.
current_limitations: No persistent storage — all records lost on process restart
No retrieval ranking — recall returns raw list order
No confidence scoring or decay tracking
No supersession detection for outdated facts
No garbage collection for stale memories

brain_kernel.current_state: ChiefBrainKernel binds MemoryController via bind_memory(). Calls memory.consolidate() on mission completion. BrainReceipt generated for decisions.

brain_protocols.current_state: MemoryControllerProtocol defined with commit/recall/consolidate. BrainComponent protocol with health().

scope_1_memory_storage_contract.description: Define the persistent storage schema and formal interface for brain memory operations. Brain state is stored in .nexara/brain_state.db — completely separate from runtime .nexara/store.db.

brain_state_db_schema.description: SQL DDL for brain_state.db with 6 tables

tables.brain_memories: Persistent memory records with layer, kind, confidence, decay, evidence_id, provenance
tables.memory_decay_state: Per-kind half-life configuration and per-record decay tracking
tables.memory_consolidation_log: Audit log of consolidation operations (episodic→semantic, short_term→long_term)
tables.memory_access_log: Access frequency tracking for reinforcement scoring
tables.memory_health_snapshots: Periodic health metric snapshots (coverage, freshness, consistency)
tables.memory_provenance_chain: Provenance records tracing each memory back to source evidence

enhanced_methods: commit() — now persists to brain_state.db, records provenance, initializes decay state
recall() — now returns ranked results with confidence scoring
consolidate() — now logs to consolidation_log, updates provenance
summary() — now reads from brain_state.db, includes health metrics

scope_2_memory_object_schema.description: Define JSON schemas for all brain-specific memory objects. These extend (do not replace) existing MemoryRecord from models.py.

schemas.description: Extended memory record with confidence, decay, access_count, provenance fields
Per-kind decay configuration: half-life (seconds), min_confidence, decay_function
Consolidation operation record: source memory_id, target memory_id, timestamp, trigger
Health metrics: total_memories, active_count, stale_count, coverage_score, freshness_score, consistency_score, layer_distribution
Provenance chain: memory_id → evidence_id → source_file → commit_sha → trace_id
Ranked retrieval result: memory_id, relevance_score, recency_score, confidence, combined_score

scope_3_memory_classification.description: Extend the existing 13 MemoryKind classification with brain-specific decay parameters and layer promotion rules.

decay_config.description: Configuration for decay parameters per MemoryKind. Default half-life values based on memory volatility.

layer_promotion_rules.description: Rules for promoting memories across layers: working→semantic (after access_count≥3), episodic→semantic (automatic on mission complete), semantic→procedural (after confidence≥0.9 and access_count≥10)

classification_extension.description: Add classify_with_confidence(kind, content, access_count) → (layer, confidence, decay_rate) to existing _classify_layer()

scope_4_memory_retrieval_interface.description: Unified retrieval API with relevance scoring, recency bias, confidence filtering, and cross-layer transparency.

scoring.relevance: TF-IDF or keyword match score against content+key

ranked_retrieval.output: List of MemoryBrainRecord sorted by combined_score DESC, capped at top_k

cross_layer_query.description: Transparent query across all 4 layers. Returns results grouped by layer with per-layer counts.

retrieval_interface_contract.description: Add RetrievalInterface protocol: rank_retrieve(), cross_layer_query(), health_report()

scope_5_memory_evidence_binding.description: Enforce evidence binding for all brain memory operations. Every write must trace back to source evidence. Provenance chain tracks full lineage.

evidence_enforcement.description: Enhanced commit() enforces evidence_id for all non-working layers. Adds provenance_chain field tracing memory_id→evidence_id→source_file→commit_sha.

provenance_chain.description: ProvenanceTracker class: record_provenance(memory_id, evidence_id, source, commit_sha) → provenance_id. get_chain(memory_id) → full lineage. verify_chain(memory_id) → integrity check.

evidence_binding_validation.description: Tests: commit without evidence_id raises ValueError for required kinds; provenance chain starts at evidence; chain is traversable forward and backward

scope_6_memory_isolation_boundary.description: Enforce strict isolation: brain_state.db is separate from store.db. Brain package has zero imports from runtime package. Runtime never imports brain.

database_isolation.description: BrainDB class — manages brain_state.db connection. Separate SQLite instance, separate file path (.nexara/brain_state.db), separate connection pool. Uses same db.py patterns but different database file.
isolation_checks: BrainDB does not import SQLiteStore from db.py (avoids accidental store.db access)
BrainDB connection string is hardcoded to .nexara/brain_state.db

rules: src/nexara_prime/brain/ MAY import from src/nexara_prime/models.py (types only)
src/nexara_prime/brain/ MAY import from src/nexara_prime/db.py (SQLiteStore pattern, not instance)
package_isolation.verification: tests/brain/test_isolation.py — grep all brain/*.py for forbidden imports, assert zero matches

memory_controller_enhancement_boundary.description: Enhancing MemoryController does NOT mean importing runtime. The MemoryController is brain-tier — it lives in brain/, uses BrainDB, and is called by ChiefBrainKernel (brain/kernel.py). The runtime (src/nexara_prime/runtime.py) never calls brain code directly.

long_term_memory_implementation.description: New LongTermMemory class wrapping MemoryController with LTM-specific operations: consolidation with reinforcement, supersession detection, garbage collection, provenance tracking.

methods: consolidate_to_ltm(memory_id) — promote short-term→long-term after access_count threshold
reinforce(memory_id) — increment access_count, update last_accessed, recalculate confidence
detect_supersession(key, new_content) — find conflicting memories, flag as superseded
garbage_collect(min_confidence=0.1, max_age_days=365) — archive low-confidence stale memories
decay_tick() — apply decay to all memories, return affected count
health_report() — LTM-specific health: consolidation_rate, supersession_rate, gc_candidates

required_coverage_areas: consolidation: short_term promotes to long_term after threshold
supersession: conflicting memory flagged, old memory marked superseded_by
garbage_collection: stale memories archived, active memories preserved
decay: confidence decreases over time, reinforcment counters decay
provenance: chain traces back to original evidence
evidence_binding: commit without evidence raises error for required kinds
isolation: long_term_memory does not access runtime store.db

read_only_reference: src/nexara_prime/models.py (MemoryKind, MemoryRecord types only — NO modification)

required_coverage_areas.checks: commit persists to brain_state.db; recall reads from db; restart recovers from db; concurrent writes are safe

rank_retrieve returns sorted by combined_score; relevance scoring works; recency bias works; confidence filtering works; cross_layer_query returns grouped results; empty query returns empty; all layers queried when layers=None
decay reduces confidence over time; different half-life per kind; reinforcement counters decay; decay never goes below min_confidence; decay_tick returns affected count

commit without evidence raises for required kinds; commit without evidence allowed for optional kinds; provenance chain starts at evidence; get_provenance returns full chain; verify_chain detects broken chain
consolidate_to_ltm after threshold; reinforce increments access_count; supersession flags conflicts; garbage_collection archives stale; decay affects LTM slower than working; provenance traces back
brain_state.db != store.db path; brain/ has zero forbidden imports; runtime has zero brain imports; MemoryController does not import runtime modules
health_report returns valid structure; coverage_score calculated correctly; freshness_score reflects decay; consistency_score detects superseded; layer_distribution is accurate
episodic→semantic automatic on consolidate(); working→semantic after access_count threshold; consolidation_log records operation; consolidated_from links preserved

acceptance_criteria: All 6 scope areas implemented and testable independently
Minimum 90 tests across 8 coverage areas, all PASS
Zero modifications to src/nexara_prime/runtime.py and other forbidden files
Existing 1151+ tests continue to PASS (no regression)
Brain state persists in .nexara/brain_state.db across process restarts
MemoryController enhanced with persistence, ranking, decay, health
LongTermMemory module operational with consolidation, reinforcement, supersession, GC
All 6 JSON schemas valid and referencable
All evidence files generated and valid

governance_gates.file_modification: ALLOWED (files in scope only — see allowed_files)
governance_gates.implementation: FROZEN — requires Claude review PASS + human approval
